offices.address: 1350 Havendale Blvd NW, Winter Haven, FL 33881, USA

about: Howell & Thornhill is a personal injury firm with a single office in Winter Haven.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

G1.evidence: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Florida on the discipline of Florida Bar members, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 1237 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Florida on the discipline of Florida Bar members, 1946 to 2026. 1 of them share a surname with a disciplined attorney and were read against the text of those decisions, which name somebody else. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile; Secretary of State registration still to confirm

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 7 named attorneys published.

G6.evidence: 229 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2000-12-08, so it has been operating for more than a year
